newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares gain in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares gain in moderate trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares regained some of the ground they lost earlier this week, rising for the second straight day in moderate trade, dealers said.
The group A index rose by 56.91 points to 2,859.93 and volume on the central market reached over 2.5 million litas.
Friday's modest gains included Birzai Dairy, which rose by 1.85 percent to 11.00 litas in trade of just over 330,000 litas.
Hermis Bank, which fell sharply earlier in the week, continued to rebound, with its shares rising 1.22 percent to 240.00 litas in turn-over of 260,000 litas.
Market leader Vilnius Bank's preference shares also gained slightly, rising by 1.88 percent to 1,630 litas in light trade of 8,150 litas.
Bloc trades worth over 1.8 million litas were also made and the secondary T-bill market turned over only 4,330 litas on Friday. -- Riga Newsroom, +371 721 5240
